name: io.github.WCAG-Compliance/mcp
title: wcagc — accessibility scanning
description: Deterministic axe-core accessibility scans (WCAG 2.1 AA, EN 301 549, PDF/UA) via your account.

environmentVariables.name: WCAGC_MCP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A wcagc API key with the mcp:scan scope. Mint one under Settings -> API keys; every plan can, with a daily quota on Free and Starter.

environmentVariables.name: WCAGC_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The wcagc API to call. Defaults to the hosted API; override only for a self-hosted deployment.
